edges.reason: flipSaleState writes the saleIsActive flag.
msg.sender must equal owner via onlyOwner to flip the sale state.
msg.sender is both the onlyOwner caller and the recipient of the contract balance.
withdraw executes the native value transfer operation.
Local balance feeds the transfer amount.
Native ETH is sent to msg.sender.
reserveTokens calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on the recipient.
onlyOwner gate and mint target both derive from msg.sender.
Local supply seeds the token ids to mint.
reserveTokens conditionally writes startingIndexBlock.
reserveCheeses calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on the recipient.
_to is the mint recipient in reserveCheeses.
_reserveAmount controls the loop bound of mints.
Local supply seeds the token ids to mint.
reserveCheeses conditionally writes startingIndexBlock.
numberOfTokens drives loop bound, payment check and supply check.
mintCheese calls _safeMint in a loop, invoking recipient callback mid-mint.
mintCheese requires saleIsActive.
mintCheese enforces totalSupply + numberOfTokens <= MAX_SUPPLY.
mintCheese enforces numberOfTokens <= MAX_NFT_PURCHASE.
mintCheese validates msg.value against cheesePrice.
mintCheese mints tokens to msg.sender.
calcStartingIndex writes startingIndex.
calcStartingIndex reads startingIndexBlock for blockhash randomness.
calcStartingIndex reduces blockhash modulo MAX_SUPPLY.
startingIndexBlock-derived blockhash provides pseudo-randomness, a weak randomness/access-control pattern.
onlyOwner restricts who can finalize the starting index.
setProvenanceHash writes FC_PROVENANCE.
provenanceHash is stored into FC_PROVENANCE.
onlyOwner restricts provenance updates to the owner.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock writes startingIndexBlock.
emergencySetStartingIndexBlock requires startingIndex == 0.
onlyOwner restricts the emergency starting index setter.
setBaseURI writes _baseURIExtended.
baseURI_ is stored into _baseURIExtended.
onlyOwner restricts base URI changes.
_baseURI returns _baseURIExtended.
tokenURI reads the per-token URI from _tokenURIs.
tokenURI calls _baseURI to build the metadata URI.
tokenId selects which token URI is returned.

normalization_plan.reason: numberOfTokens is a mintCheese argument consumed only by that function.
_to is the reserveCheeses mint recipient argument.
provenanceHash is supplied only to setProvenanceHash.
baseURI_ is supplied only to setBaseURI.
tokenId is queried only within tokenURI.
The local balance is the exact value forwarded by the withdraw native transfer.
The local supply is read from totalSupply() to seed reserved token ids in reserveTokens.
